title: Portfolio performance
explanation: TWR measures the change in value independently of deposit and withdrawal sizes. XIRR reflects their amounts and dates. TWR is annualized only for periods of at least 365 days; XIRR is not shown for periods shorter than 30 days.
range: Dates include flows from the first day; the baseline is the previous close. Table periods end on the latest available valuation date. Returns use the economic view; the view selector applies only to realized P/L.
gaps: Incomplete valuations or flows prevent calculation. An unavailable result does not mean a zero return.
